name: This guy paid an INSANE amount for Coldplay!
description:
A dude from Bangalore at a show in Mumbai - he was down for the Coldplay concert but, did not want to share how much he paid for the tickets. But, we have our ways and found out :). 

Shot at The J Spot in Juhu.
